name: Book
description: Store and manage the complete catalog of books in the library including availability status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the book

fields.name: isbn
fields.description: International Standard Book Number for unique book identification

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the book

fields.name: author
fields.description: Author name(s) of the book

fields.name: category
fields.description: Genre or category classification of the book

fields.name: publicationYear
fields.description: Year the book was published

fields.name: availabilityStatus
fields.description: Current status of the book (available, checked_out, reserved)

name: Member
description: Store library member information and membership status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the member

fields.name: membershipId
fields.description: Unique membership ID displayed on member card

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name of the library member

fields.name: email
fields.description: Email address for contact and notifications

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Contact phone number

fields.name: registrationDate
fields.description: Date when member registered with the library

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if membership is currently active

name: Transaction
description: Records book checkout and return activities with associated fees and dates

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the transaction

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Reference to the member who checked out the book

fields.name: bookId
fields.description: Reference to the book being checked out

fields.name: checkoutDate
fields.description: Date when the book was checked out

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Date when the book is due for return

fields.name: returnDate
fields.description: Actual date when the book was returned

fields.name: lateFee
fields.description: Calculated late fee amount for overdue returns

constraints.returnDateAfterCheckout: returnDate must be after checkoutDate if provided

name: Reservation
description: Manages the queue of book reservations by members for currently checked-out books

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the reservation

fields.name: bookId
fields.description: Reference to the reserved book

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Reference to the member who made the reservation

fields.name: reservedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the reservation was created

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of reservation (pending, available, fulfilled, cancelled)

fields.name: notifiedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when member was notified of book availability

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the reservation expires if not fulfilled

relationships.description: Each reservation is for one book
Each reservation is made by one member

indexes.description: Optimize queries for active reservations per book
Optimize queries for member's active reservations
Support queue ordering by reservation time

constraints.uniqueActiveReservation: A member can only have one active reservation per book
constraints.statusValues: Status must be one of: pending, available, fulfilled, cancelled
